title: Los árboles en combate: elementos, Control remoto y pasivas
description: docs/animas/README.md § The jar. The skills and passives bought as nodes of Matemágico's and Tecnópata's trees, in the fight tester against three sturdy dogs, one player leading both: Cubo acuático (Mojado), Punto eléctrico (Conducción), Pirámide ígnea, Control remoto, Vapor, and each passive saying so on a plate over whoever has it (Telemetría, Toma de tierra, Rescoldo, Capilaridad, Nanitos). Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.turn = id => document.querySelector('#battle .turn-meta')?.textContent === 'TU TURNO' && document.querySelector('.battle-dock[data-dock="1"]')?.dataset.member === id; ui.tweak(s => s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 600; }));

steps.caption: Matemágico with its three element lines bought: Foc Binari, Pirámide ígnea, Cubo acuático and Punto eléctrico
Cubo acuático: a square drawn in water light, extruded into a cube that fills with water on its way over the dogs and bursts on them. ¡Mojado! on all three
Telemetría (passive): Bip rams a wet dog and its Mojado lasts 3 s more; the plate PASIVA · Telemetría comes up over Aitor in cyan
Punto eléctrico: a point of charge rises from his circle and falls on the first dog as forking lightning; Conducción runs through the water to every wet dog and leaves them dry
Control remoto: Bip's signal threads to a dog's head, rings of nanites close round it, and it turns on one of its own in Bip's cyan
Rescoldo (passive): Foc Binari's fire lasts 15 s; its plate comes up over Gerard in gold
Pirámide ígnea: a triangle drawn in fire pulled into a pyramid that flies over the dogs and blows up; the fire on each climbs to one height and the digit of the fire they now share stands over it
All three burning at the level of the highest

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { delete f.timed; }); s.allies.find(a => a.id === 'gerard').element = 'agua'; })

steps.caption: Capilaridad (passive): Atacar with water on a dog with no fire leaves it Mojado

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { const g = s.allies.find(a => a.id === 'gerard'); g.hp = Math.max(1, g.hp - 50); g.statuses = { llorera: 2 }; })

steps.caption: Nanitos (passive): Rayo de sanación on Gerard also takes his Llorera away

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { s.allies.find(a => a.id === 'gerard').element = 'fuego'; s.foes.forEach(f => { f.timed = { ...f.timed, mojado: { level: 1, left: 20, next: 20 } }; }); })

steps.caption: Vapor: Atacar with fire on the wet dog; the water goes up and leaves it Cegado
